LanguageData.QuebrarLealdade.label: shatter loyalty
LanguageData.QuebrarLealdade.description: Wardens will attempt to psychologically break the prisoner's unwavering loyalty through intense interrogation and pressure.
LanguageData.TorturarPrisioneiro.label: physical torture
LanguageData.TorturarPrisioneiro.description: Wardens will use brutal physical methods to shatter the prisoner's unwavering loyalty. Reduces resistance twice as fast and causes bruising, but has a higher chance of destroying skill passions and guarantees a catatonic breakdown upon breaking.
